contract: Read-only anniversary projection over active, unarchived Knowledge note/journal/fleeting items and already-bound episodic MemoryService records; no new datastore or provider calls.
date_policy: Original file_metadata.original_at then source_created_at then created_at. Date-only and legacy naive stamps preserve local wall-clock date; offset timestamps convert to requested IANA timezone. Exact February 29 only. Invalid original dates are reported and skipped rather than replaced by import dates.
acceptance_coverage: Actual KnowledgeStore writes, historical source timestamps, active-source filtering and reopen persistence
Timezone calendar boundary, local legacy timestamps, original-date precedence, exact leap-day and invalid-date disclosure
Stable bounded pagination, canonical source identity and full exact-source reads
Actual SemanticArchive and MemoryService reads, deleted-memory exclusion and no embedding calls
Real aiohttp requests, two isolated stores, rejected query selectors and read-only method boundary
Actual HTTP-backed console DOM journey: source links, pagination, error recovery, empty date and URL selection
remaining_limits: Root-owned dashboard registration, navigation, agent metadata and merged browser qualification remain integration work.
Memory availability is explicit; only an already-bound episodic memory archive is read. Semantic facts do not have anniversary chronology in this slice.
Root startup should resolve state.knowledge_store before accepting requests to bind its existing lazy store to runtime home.
Projection scans existing authoritative records and does not create a competing date index. Pagination bounds returned records, not scan volume.
Legacy naive timestamps cannot reconstruct a historical capture timezone; their wall-clock policy is disclosed.
No production deployment or external/native qualification was performed.
